lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Log in as a normal user and you see your dashboard. Log in as an admin and you see something different. How does the app decide?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's the heart of AuthLaravel, a learning project Antoine built to practice access control with Laravel.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So Laravel on the back, and what on the front?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Vue pages delivered through Inertia, which lets the backend serve pages without a separate API layer. The routes show the path: authenticated users reach their dashboard, and administrators get their own view.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It works as a clean authentication template with sessions, JWT and role-based policies. It's mostly PHP, with TypeScript for the Vue pages.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A tidy starting point for any app that needs users and roles.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The full page has the route details.
